name: Optimize OBS
description: Disables telemetry, autoupdates and non-English locales across core and plugin folders to shrink footprint and speed startup.
commands:
# Run as admin. Removes non–en-US locale files from OBS folders.
 
 $iniDirs = @(
  'C:\Program Files\obs-studio\data\obs-studio\locale',
  'C:\Program Files\obs-studio\data\obs-plugins\coreaudio-encoder\locale',
  'C:\Program Files\obs-studio\data\obs-plugins\enc-amf\locale',
  'C:\Program Files\obs-studio\data\obs-plugins\frontend-tools\locale',
  'C:\Program Files\obs-studio\data\obs-plugins\image-source\locale',
  'C:\Program Files\obs-studio\data\obs-plugins\obs-ffmpeg\locale',
  'C:\Program Files\obs-studio\data\obs-plugins\obs-filters', # no "\locale" in your paths
  'C:\Program Files\obs-studio\data\obs-plugins\obs-outputs\locale',
  'C:\Program Files\obs-studio\data\obs-plugins\obs-qsv11\locale',
  'C:\Program Files\obs-studio\data\obs-plugins\obs-text\locale',
  'C:\Program Files\obs-studio\data\obs-plugins\rtmp-services\locale',
  'C:\Program Files\obs-studio\data\obs-plugins\text-freetype2\locale',
  'C:\Program Files\obs-studio\data\obs-plugins\vlc-video\locale',
  'C:\Program Files\obs-studio\data\obs-plugins\win-capture\locale',
  'C:\Program Files\obs-studio\data\obs-plugins\win-decklink\locale',
  'C:\Program Files\obs-studio\data\obs-plugins\win-dshow\locale',
  'C:\Program Files\obs-studio\data\obs-plugins\win-wasapi\locale',
  'C:\Program Files\obs-studio\data\obs-plugins\obs-browser\locale',
  'C:\Program Files\obs-studio\data\obs-plugins\obs-transitions\locale',
  'C:\Program Files\obs-studio\data\obs-plugins\obs-vst\locale',
  'C:\Program Files\obs-studio\data\obs-plugins\obs-x264\locale'
 )
 
 foreach ($d in $iniDirs) {
  if (Test-Path $d) {
  Get-ChildItem $d -Filter '*.ini' -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
  Where-Object { $_.Name -ne 'en-US.ini' } |
  Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  }
 }
 
 # Chromium .pak locales
 $pakDir = 'C:\Program Files\obs-studio\obs-plugins\64bit\locales'
 if (Test-Path $pakDir) {
  Get-ChildItem $pakDir -Filter '*.pak' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
  Where-Object { $_.Name -ne 'en-US.pak' } |
  Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
 }
